findings: Changing the idempotency-key format for an existing checkout attempt can cause retries after deployment to use a different key, defeating prior idempotency and potentially creating duplicate charges/orders.
evidence: The key changes from `${request.orderId}:${request.attemptNumber}` to `${request.orderId}|${request.attemptNumber}` with no compatibility handling shown.
checked: Potential ambiguity in delimiter-based key composition
gaps: No evidence of a migration/dual-read strategy, key versioning, or confirmation that old keys are not persisted or sent to an external payment provider.
No evidence that orderId and attemptNumber cannot contain the selected delimiter; delimiter substitution alone does not make concatenated keys unambiguous.
